covers: The NEC uPD7759 ADPCM speech chip as a chip

left_out.why: mask-ROM variant with no MD pin, no DRQ output and no slave mode, and a different sample address shift (none, against one in the uPD7759), so md_w and the slave protocol of these entries do not exist on it

entries.name: NEC uPD7759
entries.description: Speech chip that plays ADPCM samples from an external ROM, chosen by number in stand-alone mode or fed byte by byte by the host in slave mode.
entries.behaviour: Inputs are RESET, START, MD and an 8-bit port; outputs are BUSY and, on this class, DRQ. Stand-alone mode starts a sample from the ROM table when START falls. Slave mode asks the host for every byte through DRQ.
